title: “Lost-in-the-Later” : Framework for Quantifying Contextual Grounding in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: The paper measures positional bias by segmenting input contexts into atomic sentences, dividing the context into quartiles (early to late segments), and computing a Context Recall (CR) distribution to quantify how models disproportionately rely on earlier information while underutilizing later segments (termed the 'lost-in-the-later' effect).
